labelerView.description: Public projection of a registry labeler row, shared by the getLabelers and getLabeler queries. Internal fields (last_error, require_sig, updated_at) are deliberately excluded.

endpoint.description: Labeler service endpoint URL. Stays empty until discovery resolves the endpoint for the labeler.

source.description: How the labeler was registered: discovered from the firehose, or added manually via the admin API.

enabled.description: Whether the relay subscribes to this labeler's upstream stream.

last_upstream_seq.description: Sequence number last ingested from the labeler's upstream stream. null when the labeler has never been observed.
